LESSON: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Call of Disciples
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Call of Disciples, part of The Life of Jesus Christ in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Call of Disciples in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. state how different people are called to serve God today,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Call of Disciples in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. serve God in his or her daily life to grow spiritually.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Call of Disciples in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures,

   The Call of Disciples helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. state how different people are called to serve God today,

   The Call of Disciples helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. serve God in his or her daily life to grow spiritually.

   The Call of Disciples helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss, in small groups, different roles they play in church and share in class

2. in turns, read Mark 1:16- 20 and retell the call of the first disciples,

3. watch a video clip on the call of the first disciples

4. role-play the call of the first disciples,

5. compose and sing a song on the call of the first four disciples,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss, in small groups, different roles they play in church and share in class
2. in turns, read Mark 1:16- 20 and retell the call of the first disciples,
3. watch a video clip on the call of the first disciples
4. role-play the call of the first disciples,
5. compose and sing a song on the call of the first four disciples,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Call of Disciples together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: the skill of digital citizenship is enhanced as learners watch a video clip on the call of the first disciples.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: active listening and communication skills are enhanced as learners follow simple

instructions.

• Self-efficacy: the skill of knowing self is enhanced as learners share with others the different activities they perform in church.

18

Values:
• Responsibility: learners work diligently in assigned roles and duties in church.

• Unity: learners display team spirit as they role-play the call of the first disciples.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Human rights and responsibilities: is enhanced as learners participate in different activities at home, school and in church.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners compose and sing a song on the call of the first disciples.

• English: speaking skills are enhanced as learners retell the call of the first disciples.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures,
2. state how different people are called to serve God today,
3. serve God in his or her daily life to grow spiritually.

Remember the key question: How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?
